# ALLSTARS COLLECTIBLES

> A World Cup 2026 trading card gacha machine — pull packs, build your collection, and compete on the leaderboard.

## About

ALLSTARS COLLECTIBLES is an animated collectibles experience built around the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Users pull virtual trading card packs featuring 100 real players across four rarity tiers: Common, Rare, Epic, and Legendary. Pulls are animated, legendary cards trigger confetti, and a live leaderboard ranks collectors globally.

## Key URL

- Homepage (full app): https://1fc4166e-6057-4eee-8b23-b73cdfb681c7-00-1pazzd3q9zv8c-033n9pad.pike.replit.dev/

## Content Sections

- **Pull** — Single and 10-card pack pulls with animated card flip reveals
- **Vault** — Browse all 100 player cards; locked cards shown as silhouettes until unlocked
- **Rankings** — Live leaderboard ranked by legendary count then total cards collected
- **Live Feed** — Real-time stream of notable pulls (Rare and above) from all users
- **Chat** — Shared live chat room for all collectors

## Rarity System

| Rarity    | Count | Approx Pull Rate |
|-----------|-------|-----------------|
| Legendary | 10    | ~1%             |
| Epic      | 20    | ~6%             |
| Rare      | 30    | ~19%            |
| Common    | 40    | ~74%            |

The 10-card pack guarantees at least one Rare-or-above per pull.
